table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ClassCode=StudentClass.ClassCode,   
	ClassName = Class.Name,
	StudentCode=Student.StudentCode,   
	RollNo=StudentClass.RollNo,   
	RegNo=Student.RegNo,   
	StudentName=Student.Name,   
	FatherName=Student.FName  
FROM 
	Student,   
	StudentClass,
	Class
WHERE 
	StudentClass.StudentCode = Student.StudentCode and  
	StudentClass.PromotionRowID is NULL AND  
	StudentClass.GraduationRowID is NULL AND  
	StudentClass.ClassCode in (:ai_classcode)  AND
	StudentClass.ClassCode = Class.ClassCode AND
	Class.Active = 'Y'
ORDER BY
	ClassName,
	StudentName,
	RollNo
